message:
This PR updates the `trailing-whitespace` pre-commit hook configuration to also check `.txt` files for trailing whitespace, in addition to the currently supported MDX and YAML files, and fixes existing trailing whitespace issues discovered by the updated hook.

## Changes Made

### 1. Updated Pre-commit Configuration

Updated the `files` pattern in `.pre-commit-config.yaml` from:
```yaml
- id: trailing-whitespace
  files: \.(mdx|ya?ml)$
```

To:
```yaml
- id: trailing-whitespace
  files: \.(mdx|ya?ml|txt)$
```

### 2. Fixed Existing Trailing Whitespace Issues

After updating the hook configuration, ran pre-commit to identify and fix existing trailing whitespace in `.txt` files:
- Fixed trailing whitespace in `requirements/doc-requirements.txt`
- Fixed trailing whitespace in `tests/langchain/state_of_the_union.txt` (365 lines cleaned)

## Why This Change

The repository contains numerous `.txt` files (LICENSE.txt, requirements.txt files, data files, etc.) that should be checked for trailing whitespace to maintain consistent code quality. Previously, these files were not covered by the trailing-whitespace hook.

## Testing

- ✅ Verified the hook now processes `.txt` files (previously skipped)
- ✅ Confirmed existing functionality for MDX and YAML files remains unchanged
- ✅ Tested with actual `.txt` files in the repository
- ✅ Created test files with trailing whitespace to confirm detection and auto-fixing works correctly
- ✅ Ran all pre-commit hooks to ensure no regressions
- ✅ Successfully cleaned up existing trailing whitespace issues found by the updated hook

## Impact

This change ensures that all `.txt` files in the repository will be automatically checked for trailing whitespace during pre-commit, helping maintain consistent code quality across all text-based files.
